title: Marvel Super Heroes (USA) V1.001: late-code candidate
summary: Deliver the two NOPs from MSH.BIN and select 1 MiB expansion RAM.
rationale: MSH.BIN begins at LBA 1082 and loads at 06002000, mapping both exact handler targets to FAD 1250. The US branch is guarded by two 23301FF0 words. The inherited handler calls 060D0FF4, then selects 1 MiB RAM and applies the NOPs. A fixed-clock emulator control redirects only the inherited first-program pointer and executes the exact compiled menu handler/helper at their original addresses with 1 MiB RAM preselected. Video matches at all 121 checkpoints through frame 7201; US audio CRC 57/121 and sample counts 116/121 match. The normal menu-address control retains complete PCM differences. A diagnostic changing only its handler/helper cartridge-space reads to emulator Work RAM timing matches every candidate PCM byte and all 121 sampled outputs in the three retail releases. This isolates the emulator discrepancy to modeled read timing; no audible defect or need for production delay is established. Physical cartridge timing and other paths remain open; keep inactive.
